rationale: C04 is a near-verbatim predecessor directed to the same House Committee on Un-American Activities and the same Rule XI investigative authority. The child preserves C04's complete operative structure and administrative machinery while updating the return cutoff, Congress, and resolution date. C24 and C02 share the same contemporary tax-return-inspection framework and Treasury Decisions, but concern different committees and investigations.
